scope: Internal same-heap cooperative locks and condition variables. Public Bordeaux Threads APIs and application scheduler entry points remain separate work.

implementation.locks: Task identity ownership, recursive depth, FIFO handoff, nonblocking/timed acquisition, waiter removal and timer cleanup. A cancelled waiter relinquishes ownership even if granted before its promise continuation ran.
implementation.conditions: Atomically enqueue and release without a suspension between them. Notify one or broadcast. Reacquire the lock and original recursive depth before normal return, timeout or exceptional unwinding. Repeated cancellation while reacquiring preserves the first interruption.
implementation.synchronous: Ordinary startup may acquire/release uncontended locks. Ordinary condition calls fail before releasing ownership. Manually stepped unscheduled execution contexts cannot silently share an owner token.
implementation.timeouts: Internal milliseconds; chunk long timers to avoid the host signed 32-bit timeout limit. Condition timeout does not bypass reacquisition: it can return later while another owner still holds the lock.

coverage: 64 tasks protect 192 interleaved shared read-modify-write operations
recursive depth, nonblocking acquisition, zero/finite timeouts and ownership errors
cancel queued and granted-but-not-resumed waiters; clear long timer
notify one of 64 condition waiters, broadcast remaining 63
repeated cancellation restores recursive depth before unwind
ordinary condition and unscheduled task rejection leave ownership intact

node.command: npm --prefix tests run build:resumable && npm --prefix tests run test:resumable

browser.scope: Load and supplied API assertions; GUI verification is separate

browserReproduction: Concatenate performance/resumable.lisp, resumable/checks.lisp, callbacks.lisp, scheduler.lisp, eval.lisp, synchronization.lisp and alexandria-checks.lisp. Run probe.mjs alexandria REPORT CHECKS --browser valtan-resumable --after-load=AFTER. AFTER concatenates scheduler-checks.mjs, eval-checks.mjs and synchronization-checks.mjs and awaits all three verifiers; disable fileCompilation in the browser EVAL verifier.
remaining: These internal primitives do not yet expose the Bordeaux Threads v1/v2 APIs or Lisp condition types.
Thread lifecycle, join/interrupt and default special bindings need their public adapter.
SLEEP still blocks the host; scheduled sleep and other blocking host operations require resumable paths.
Application drivers require scheduler entry integration.
Existing long McCLIM/Drei workers have earlier snapshots; no full McCLIM verification is claimed.
